source_boundary: Drain3 supplies message-template clustering. Header parsing, severity counts, baseline ordering and comparison, stable IDs, Markdown/HTML/JSON report behavior, and operator-facing limits are local project code and are tested separately. No anomaly accuracy, diagnosis, benchmark, incident detection, or business-value claim follows from the copied source or its paper.
